# gezor_pipeline_notebook (Resource)

A notebook used by Pipeline Designer steps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gezor_pipeline_notebook" "clean_orders" {
  cluster_id = gezor_cluster.prod.id
  path       = "silver/clean_orders.sql"
  language   = "sql"
  content    = file("${path.module}/notebooks/clean_orders.sql")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster id.
- `path` (String) Notebook path, for example `bronze/orders.sql`.

### Optional

- `content` (String)
- `language` (String) `sql` or `python`.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Notebook id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax. Append `@<workspace>` to import from a workspace other than the provider default.

```shell
terraform import gezor_pipeline_notebook.example <cluster_id>/<notebook_id>
```
